decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system is a multi-model line built on the established office offer and fits the announced flexible-workplace direction, so the investment and strategic fit argue for persisting.
The chair family is close to the core offer and needs little extra investment to maintain, so management keeps it and can attribute any weak sales to temporary pandemic effects.
The carpet floor cushions are a niche accessory, but they are tied to the rug flagship and already invested in, so management prefers to continue them rather than admit a misstep.
The designer sofa by EOOS was publicly launched with prominent storytelling and is central to the residential lounge identity, which creates strong commitment to keep it.
The high standing table is a low-cost complement to the office and conference offer and supports the flexible-workplace narrative, so it is kept.

The rug collection was presented as a flagship of the firm's direction and represents a large, visible investment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors persisting despite its distance from the core.
